name: Simons Observatory
summary: CMB temperature and polarization observatory with multiple telescope apertures, using lensing and cosmic structure to study dark matter alongside objectives such as primordial gravitational waves.
detection_principle: Cryogenic millimeter-wave detectors measure multifrequency CMB temperature and polarization, reconstructing gravitational lensing and matter distributions.

status.label: Partly operating, with further construction continuing
status.evidence: Three SATs are operating. The LAT achieved first light in 2025-02 and is progressing toward science operation; first light does not mean completion of a full survey's results.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
